title: The battle without the gods
intro: The gods have withdrawn after Book V. Mortal battle resumes; Axylus' hospitality cannot save him.

notes.text: οἰόω, leave alone: 3sg aor pass; the fighting is left to mortals. οἶος = alone.
φύλοπις, battle-din / combat (fem); αἰνός, terrible. Subject of οἰώθη.
“Repeatedly … this way and that”; πολλά adverbial, ἔνθα, here / there.
ἰθύω, rush straight: unaugmented 3sg impf; gen of space traversed, “across the plain.”
ἰθύνω, direct / aim: pres mid ptc gen pl; gen absolute, “as they aimed at one another.”
χαλκήρης, fitted with bronze: acc neut pl; δόρυ, spear: epic pl δοῦρα.
μεσσηγύς + gen, between; ἰδέ, and; ῥοή, stream: gen pl -άων. Xanthus is also called Scamander.
“Bulwark of the Greeks”; ἕρκος, fence / defensive barrier (neut), apposition to Ajax.
ῥήγνυμι, break: unaugmented 3sg aor; φάλαγξ, battle-line: acc sg.
φόως = φῶς, light, here relief / deliverance; τίθημι 3sg aor, “brought light to his companions.”
Θρᾷξ, Thracian: epic dat pl; τεύχω perf-system 3sg plup mid/pass, “was / had been made.”
ἠΰς, good / noble: acc masc sg; familiar epic epithet in an unfamiliar stem.
κόρυς, helmet: gen sg; φάλος, crest-piece / projection: acc sg; ἱπποδάσεια, thick with horsehair.
Two accusatives after ἔβαλε: person struck and part struck, “hit him on the helmet's crest.”
μέτωπον, forehead: dat sg; πήγνυμι, fix / drive in: unaugmented 3sg aor act; spear understood as object.
περάω, pierce / pass through: unaugmented 3sg aor; αἰχμή, spear-point, delayed subject. ὀστέον, bone; εἴσω, inward.
ὄσσε, the two eyes: acc dual. σκότος, darkness, is subject of κάλυψεν.
πέφνω / θείνω, slay: 3sg reduplicated 2aor; recognize φεν-/φν-, not the present stem.
“Good at the war-cry”; βοή acc of respect.
Τευθρανίδης, son of Teuthras: acc sg. ναίω, dwell: 3sg impf; ἐϋκτίμενος, well-built.
ἀφνειός, rich; βίοτος, livelihood / possessions: gen sg -οιο, “rich in substance.”
φιλέω, welcome / entertain: iterative impf, “used to show hospitality”; uncontracted -έε- + -σκ-.
“Living in a house beside the road”; ἔπι = ἐπί, postposed + dat; ναίω can take acc of dwelling.
ἀρκέω, ward off: 3sg aor; λυγρός, grievous; ὄλεθρος, destruction. οἱ dat, for Axylus.
ὑπαντιάζω, meet / confront: aor act ptc nom sg; “stepping in front to face [the enemy].”
ἀπαυράω, rob of: 3sg impf; double acc, both men and life. Diomedes is the unexpressed subject.
θεράπων, attendant: acc sg; ὑφηνίοχος, charioteer. ἔσκεν: iterative past of εἰμί.
τώ nom dual; δύω, enter / sink: 3dual root aor act; “both went beneath the earth.”
ἐξεναρίζω, kill / strip: 3sg aor; catalogue of deaths continues next page.
